heading: A results-driven social media manager who blends creativity with strategy.
paragraphs: I have hands-on experience building and managing digital communities for tech, fashion and food brands. I create engaging, on-brand content that connects with audiences and drives measurable growth.

My work runs from content ideas and captions to tracking performance and optimizing campaigns with data. I manage communities too, keeping a brand's voice consistent while replying to comments and direct messages professionally.
platformsLine: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X and LinkedIn.
